symptom: Grinding / whining noise from gearbox after months of use; worsens under load.

probable_causes.cause: centre distance drifted (bearing wear / housing wear)
tooth wear or chipping from debris
probable_causes.evidence_to_collect: inspect tooth flanks; look for pitting on pitch line

procedures: 2. open housing; photograph gear mesh before touching
3. check bearings for roughness by hand-rotation
5. if bearing rough -> replace bearing (608ZZ, cheap); if centre distance ok and teeth pitted -> replace gear pair
verification: after rebuild: run at no load 5 min, then load; noise should not recur
safety_notes: rotating machinery: guards back on before power
